notes: The source page is for a different award: 'Medical Assisting: Combined Administrative/Clinical - Certificate of Achievement' (Plan Code 3608), not 'Medical Assisting: Administrative Option'. No section for the Administrative Option appears in the text, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded for it.

Evidence of mismatch: the combined certificate totals 31-33 units, above the award band (16 to fewer than 30 units), and it requires MA 280, MA 282 and MA 286 (clinical courses), none of which are on the closed list.

For reviewer reference, the combined certificate lists: Required Courses (25-26 units): ANAT 41 4-5 or BIO 60; AH 60 3; AH 276 1; MA 270 3; MA 280 3; MA 282 3; MA 286 4; MA 288 1; MA 290 3. Then one of two Administrative Options (6-7 units): Accounting Option (ACCTG 200 3, COSA 1 1, COSA 10 3; 7 units) or Database Option (COSA 15 3, COSA 25 3; 6 units). Total 31-33 units.

The combined certificate page prints Program Student Learning Outcomes ('Demonstrate clinical patient skills', 'Demonstrate administrative patient skills.', 'Demonstrate medical office employability skills') and names the role 'Administrative/Clinical Medical Assistant'; these were not recorded because they belong to the combined award.
The correct Administrative Option catalog page should be retrieved and read.
